preserved_boundaries: ISE-01..06 remain completed_verified with no reopened implementation authority.

ISE-08 multiplayer/accessibility/performance golden proof remains unauthorized until ISE-07 completion.
No paid provider activation, unauthorized media redistribution, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
next_action: Selected_not_started. Wait for a future owner Continue; then perform a bounded ISE-07 governed-start transition before creating a branch or implementing product code.
